_doc: Copy and adapt: mf new <id> --repo <repo> --from /opt/myflow/templates/task.example.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Template vars in commands/env: {wt} worktree, {lane} {task} {run} per-invocation dir, {gpu} {seed} {lane_dir} private dir (cache/, tmp/) {task_dir} {repo} {base}.
title: QSA union fp8 prefill speedup
goal: m12000 kv_slots TP2 fp8_tensor: union+direct kernel time -20% without breaking op_test

commands._doc: Commands run with cwd={wt} via bash -c. bench must print one line per case: MF_METRIC case=<name> value=<number>. correctness: exit 0 = pass. Test principle (three kinds): correctness = basic functional tests (few, short, run on every mf try); verify_extra = other coverage tests (only what basic and performance tests cannot cover; run in clean worktrees at prep / close); bench = performance tests (at least one case per tier). Keep basic and other coverage tests in one test file separated by comment regions, mark basic tests with @pytest.mark.basic: correctness = pytest <file> -m basic, verify_extra = pytest <file> -m 'not basic'; do not add new test files.

perf._doc: Display only (not the contract). Tables show TB/s and TFLOPS of every implementation compared when the bench prints flops= / bytes= (per call) on MF_METRIC and MF_REF lines; peaks give the share of peak (here MI308X: HBM 5.3 TB/s, FP8 dense ~606 TFLOPS). A frozen bench that prints throughput elsewhere: extract = {tbps|tflops|ref_tbps|ref_tflops: regex with named groups case and value}.
